purpose: Diagnose avoidable presentation work after #211. A null performance finding is valid; the phone-close focus correction is separate from any latency claim.
ordering: AB, BA, AB, BA, AB, in declared case order; one unrecorded warm-up of the case before each recorded trial
completion: Post-frame DOM samples: native rAF followed by a zero-delay task. Earliest sample after which every relevant visible actor stays within the declared tolerances of a verified stable final pose. Departures finish when their effective opacity or clipped visible extent falls below tolerance and stays there. Include declared ancestors, inert retiring ghosts and CSS icon/dialog transitions. Marker clearance and #211 proxies are separate observations. This is styled-DOM submission, not physical display presentation.
acknowledgment: After-dispatch witness: window-bubble microtask after target/document handlers, with an explicit next-task fallback for stopped propagation. Authoritative logical state, focused element, immediate values and intended action. Keep native event timestamp, handler witness, task/frame observations and side-panel transport distinct. A capture-listener microtask is not an after-dispatch witness.
excess: Report independent completion minus acknowledgment minus the unchanged SPRING.duration. Also retain first relevant spring start, per-owner/channel generations, dynamic target changes, last restart, marker clearance and CSS work. Negative excess is valid.
validity: Verify actor counts, actual destination order/membership and intended logical result. Repeated no-op actions, unsupported capability paths, superseded requests, missing/censored endpoints and unstable final poses retain explicit outcomes and raw samples; they are never successful zero-duration reorders.

improvement.primaryStatistic: Median paired baseline minus candidate independent completion, separately per declared case
improvement.noiseFloor: Maximum of the case A/A p95 absolute paired difference and two median sampled frame intervals
improvement.hostPolicy: Collect initial A/A before product edits. Any later A/B run first repeats A/A on that same worker with the same protocol; use the larger initial/current floor. Shared-worker variability remains a limitation. A changed metric or instrument requires a fresh pre-candidate baseline.
improvement.materialCriterion: Paired median improvement exceeds the frozen A/A floor, at least four of five pairs improve, and a corresponding unnecessary restart/chaining/work-count reduction is demonstrated with unchanged logical/visual endpoints
improvement.noChange: If no avoidable work is demonstrated under the unchanged movement contract, retain the null finding. Never shorten motion to satisfy this issue. A focused phone-close focus repair does not constitute a latency gain.

budgetEvidence: Run the existing motion guard unchanged against the explicit #211 baseline. Retain absolute budget outcomes and relative guard outcomes separately. A shared CI host and side-panel diagnostics do not certify designated-host or cumulative #96 acceptance.
